subject: prd/review-feedback-capture
statement: When a captured comment results in a change, the system shall link its entry to the resolving artifact (commit or amendment id) and make the amendment `Learned-from: review-thread` citation resolve to that entry.
rationale: provenance edge; upgrade the dead pointer (J2, M4)
fit_criterion: for a change driven by a captured comment, the entry names the resolving artifact and the artifact's `Learned-from` resolves to the entry by the citation grammar
